Initial release of phy-social-suite — unified social media content pipeline.

- Chains content atom selection, AI signature audit, and platform-specific rule checks into a single pre-publish command.
- Outputs combined PASS/FAIL verdicts with actionable feedback for content fixes.
- Supports LinkedIn, Reddit, Twitter/X, and HackerNews.
- Skips unavailable component skills, noting missing stages in output.
- Requires no external dependencies.
